the development of memory tests and reference data for the assessment of memory in clinical settings.
developing normative reference data and psychometric properties of three memory tests.

the tests are reliable, valid and have good psychometric properties.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided Danish normative data for three tests that can be used in the clinical evaluation of cognitive function.
the Danish versions of FCRST, CCMT- 48 and LM are reliable tests with a high internal consistency and good psychometric properties.

we have developed Danish versions of FSCRT, CCMT and LM with normative data and we hope that these will be used by neuropsychologists in Denmark.
